author: 3yki4nn
quote: The game itself isn't bad, it has good graphics and the story isn't bad, but it definitely doesn't deserve the 99 in metacritic. The game has multiple bugs and it had only 32 fps, cyberpunk was criticized for much less. Plus, the amount of money it costs vs how it actually is... I don't think it's worth it

game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
